body.label: Trigger
body.html: You or an adjacent ally would be forcibly moved or knocked Prone.

body.label: Effect
body.html: A Golem aspect braces the target. Reduce forced movement by 2 units or prevent Prone.

surges.html: After this Reaction resolves, gain +1 Defense until your next turn.
After this Reaction resolves, move one normal Condition between you and one willing ally within 3 units.
